newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Datacraft hits new high of US$3.10.
newsitem.headline: Datacraft hits new high of US$3.10.

text.p: Datacraft Asia Ltd shares hit a record high of US$3.10 in moderate dealings on Tuesday.
At 0753 GMT, the stock was changing hands at $3.06, up 17 cents ar about six percent. Volume was 477,000 shares.
Dealers said there was fresh buying of Datacraft shares on the back of a newspaper report that Datacraft was featured as one of the top stock picks in Singapore in a U.S. magazine.
"The stock is a serious market favourite. I do not know of one house which has called for a sell on the company in the last six months," said David Leow, investment analyst with HSBC James Capel.
Leow said the company, which focused on systems network integration, was a "play on the increasing demand for technology in Asia".
"It is very well managed and has an impressive growth rate. The story is very easy to sell," he said.
Leow said at current levels, Datacraft was "richly priced".
"It is just buying on momentum and valuations are a bit irrelevant," he said.
